For the record, you summary is not accurate.

There's quite a few pieces of the puzzle missing here.

To be completely honest, I also slightly resent the comment about "a very simple narrative," considering that there is no narrative yet. Parts 1, 2, and 3 have all been worldbuilding set up to 4, 5, and 001.

item.content:encoded:
+ Show whatever
- Hide whatever

Adebeyo's eyes widened, "The thirteenth? Are you certain of that?"

The way this is structured grammatically it looks like Adebeyo's eyes are widening in such a way as though they communicate the sentence, even as I believe he's implied to just speak it. I think this'd benefit from turning the comma into a period.

The short man's voice was soft, and fatherly "Remember,

I think you need a colon after fatherly; otherwise, it feels like it just cuts off.

Astrologians…" the words faded away as they

Think 'the" should be capitalized.

heavy door of what looked like some kind of obsidian

This could be worded better. Just 'of' is a little vague and not directly or immediately indicative of material. Maybe 'composed of?' 'Cut from?' etc.

looked like some kind of obsidian

Are there different types? From a google search (of course the most comprehensive and in-depth research any man could possibly imagine) it looks like there's just the specific rock and different colors of it.

im not geology though.

performing some major feat of mastery

snickers internally

Beautiful aren't they?" A woman called out

This sounded in my head like it needed a comma after beautiful, or it'd be one quick rush of 'beautifularenthey' - though it could be fine at large and just a personal issue. Don't think this is an issue grammatically.

She wore robes of Sky blue

Don't know why is capital.

ask you to come here for something specific.

Think should be question mark, since is question.

Ehhhhh. Yes, I like the wizard dueling stuff. Yes, I like all the alchemical lore you're building into this universe. Problems I had were the latter felt very hamfisted and for such a complex and wide reaching topic this appears on the surface at least now to be a very simple narrative and is written as such.

+ Show spoilers
- Hide whatever

In my brief read Ruslav Russian Wizard(tm) is a magical replicant who was deathmurder-built by another wizard who died who belonged to this big castle of wizards, and after learning himself how to wizard he goes to the castle with a note from Dead-izard that says he should join because he's swell. The Big Castle makes sure he's a wizard and then lets him join their club. One of them doesn't like it and challenges him to a dance battle. He loses and the story ends on a cliff hanger.

It is not doing too much for me as of right now simply because the characterization seems pretty shallow - it feels like Ruslav's defining trait is that he is slav - and the narrative that is supposed to ground this whole new avenue of the scpkipverse isn't particularly gripping or engaging.

I still look forward to the next part and your 001 because the lore is cool and I like watching Ruslav play ranked. Tenative +nyet.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Modern_Erasmus, and Pedantique on chat are basically the co-authors at this point, having a serious heavy impact on the effectiveness of this series.

I owe them both a huge thank you for their reading of the drafts, and helping me refine these ideas.

With the posting of the third tale, I'm officially announcing my 001 project's start. Until I finish parts of it, I don't plan on posting any more Alchemy Division tales, however, I will be writing them.

Theoretically, I'd like to have parts 4 and 5, and my 001 done and released on Halloween, 2017. I'm not going to strictly promise that, as who knows what TF will happen between now and then.

I should be releasing part 1 of my 001 within the next month or two. Stay tuned folks, and thanks for reading :U
